messages:
Ava (AE): Hey team — Nebula Labs POC kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT. Quick sync here to lock success criteria, who’s joining, and any non-negotiable enterprise blockers. Agenda draft below, please react or reply with changes.

Diego (SE): I’ll bring the eval harness and a sample prompt set. Need to confirm dataset size and latency SLOs.

Maya (Solutions Eng): Added: confirm login method (SSO vs invite) and whether they want private deployment or dedicated capacity for the trial.

Ava (AE): Nebula asked for 3 things explicitly: 1) generative answer quality for product FAQs, 2) ingestion latency for new docs < 5m, 3) cost estimate for expected throughput.

Diego (SE): Proposed success metrics (please critique):
- Quality: >= 85% helpfulness on a 100-case prompt set (customer-labeled) OR >=0.75 answer precision@1 on closed-book QA.
- Latency: p95 inference < 450ms for 2k token prompts (no batching), p99 < 900ms.
- Availability: 99.9% during office hours (9am–6pm local).
- Throughput: sustain 20 RPS with tail latency targets.
- Cost: projected < $0.015 per 1k tokens at expected utilization (we’ll model both PAYG and reserved).

Maya (Solutions Eng): Add evaluation artifacts:
- Prompt set (50 canonical + 50 adversarial)
- Synthetic rate test plan (locust script)
- Regression checks for hallucination categories (hallucinated-entity, invented-date, incorrect-citation)

Diego (SE): Sharing sample eval command and prompt format:
```bash
# run the harness locally against staging endpoint
python eval/run_eval.py --endpoint https://staging.redwood.api/generate \
  --prompts data/nebula_prompts.json --out results/nebula_eval.json
```
Prompts will include explicit scoring fields: expected_answer, matches_strict, must_contain_entities.

Rohit (CISO): Security redlines from Nebula’s questionnaire we need to confirm before kickoff: SSO via SAML, retention policy (30/90/365 days), encryption at rest + KMS integration, and whether any PHI will be processed. Also need to know if they require on-prem package or VPC.

Ava (AE): Good call. Nebula indicated in intake form: SSO required, likely 90 day retention, and they flagged PCI/PHI as a possible future scope (not in scope for initial dataset). For kickoff we should confirm no PHI in initial dataset.

Kevin (Sales Ops): For pricing conversation: they’re looking for a short-term committed pool for the POC (30 days) vs PAYG. We should prepare two quotes: (A) reserved 4-GPU block with guaranteed throughput and (B) PAYG with autoscaling and a buffer for burst traffic. Note: finance needs a quick estimate of minimum commit to hit target unit cost.

Maya (Solutions Eng): Operational checklist for tomorrow:
- Nebula attendees: engineering lead, security lead, product owner.
- Redwood side: Diego (SE) will demo, Maya will run eval, Ava will own success criteria and contract questions.
- Pre-kickoff deliverable: share eval prompt set + ingestion script by EOD today.

Ava (AE): Timeline proposal:
1) Day 0 (kickoff): align success criteria, access, and dataset cadence.
2) Day 1–3: ingest and baseline runs.
3) Day 4–7: iterative tuning (quantization/batching configs), run final eval.
4) Day 8: review call + decision (go/no-go).
They asked for a 2-week window, but I suggested 8–10 calendar days to be lean.

Diego (SE): One blocker to flag: if Nebula requires VPC/private deployment, provisioning can add ~3 business days. If they accept dedicated-hosted with a private dataset and SAML, we can do faster.

Rohit (CISO): Also note: if they want SOC2 evidence or contract language changes, legal needs 3–5 business days. We should surface that in kickoff.

Ava (AE): Action items before kickoff — please confirm here:
- Diego: drop initial harness and 25 canonical prompts (EOD)
- Maya: test locust script against staging and post results (EOD)
- Kevin: two preliminary pricing options (reserved vs PAYG) by morning
- Rohit: one-page security checklist snippet I can share with Nebula
If no objections I’ll post the final agenda and invite list.

Kevin (Sales Ops): Acked. I’ll also include a short note on billing cadence and PO vs CC options.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/redwood-poc (green) — baseline model v2.1 deployed to staging at 2025-12-02T08:26:40Z :rocket:

Maya (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: all set from my side, will ping when harness artifacts are uploaded.

Ava (AE): Thanks — if anyone thinks the success metrics are too strict/loose call it out now. Otherwise I’ll send to Nebula and lock the 10am kickoff invite.
